cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our table-tennis rematch decides who cleans up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. One game.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And whose cleaning method we use all year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not what I agreed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's ask the whole club to witness the clarification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.text: Fine. Take the other end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's cold now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What were you waiting for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're okay?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're okay?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was embarrassed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.
